text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Accumulation counts only the cells upstream inside this patch; ArcGIS Pro counts every upstream cell in the DEM, so its numbers here are much larger.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A cell's own count never includes itself: the headwater cells read 0.
